## 1. Background and Definitions

- AA-level c-DAR: any non-human species harbouring the human-pathogenic amino acid.
- NT-level c-DAR: the species also uses the exact same codon as the human mutation.
- Compensated vs uncompensated DAVs (cDAV / uDAV).
